title: The Saltling That Thrices
story: In the mirror-flat salt pans, Mr 6 meets a crystal sprite that triples itself every single time a sword touches it. Right now there is exactly 1 Quarnelith, and the villagers want it herded into the empty brine cistern, which holds 300 sprites.
question: If Mr 6 taps it 5 times, how many sprites short of filling the cistern would the swarm be?
solution: Each tap triples the swarm: 1 → 3 → 9 → 27 → 81 → 243 sprites after 5 taps.
The swarm would be 57 sprites short of filling it.
praise: Tripling step by step was exactly right — the final step was comparing 243 to the cistern's 300.
hint: Write the swarm after each tap: 1, then ×3, then ×3 again — five times. Then compare it with 300.
victory: Mr 6 stops at five taps, hands the 243 sparkling sprites a broom each, and the salt pans have never been so tidy. Quarnelith beams: nobody ever gave it a job before.
imagePrompt: A numeral-six knight standing on gleaming white salt flats surrounded by hundreds of tiny tripling crystal sprites that sparkle like broken glass under a wide pink dawn sky.
